subject.title: fix: harden cloud worker admission and remote turns

question: Should this PR merge only after Crabbox v0.38.1+ is published and verified through supported install channels, with the fail-closed AWS upgrade impact explicitly accepted?
rationale: The code is technically sound, but its required provider attestation is absent from the latest supported Crabbox release and existing AWS workers will become unavailable rather than retain the older permissive behavior.

options.title: Publish dependency, then merge
options.body: Release and verify Crabbox v0.38.1+, refresh the PR on current main, and merge only after clean exact-head proof confirms the coordinated upgrade.

options.title: Merge before dependency release
options.body: Land the OpenClaw hardening immediately and intentionally accept that supported Crabbox v0.38.0 AWS workers will fail admission until operators upgrade.

recommendation.title: Publish dependency, then merge
recommendation.body: Release and verify Crabbox v0.38.1+, refresh the PR on current main, and merge only after clean exact-head proof confirms the coordinated upgrade.
